paper_title: Unifying inflation with the axion, dark matter, baryogenesis and the seesaw mechanism
notes: Theoretical model paper (SMASH) unifying inflation, axion DM, baryogenesis, seesaw. Predicts an axion DM mass window 50-200 ueV (fA ~ 3e10 to 1.2e11 GeV) but presents no experimental exclusion limit or coupling exclusion curve. The mA-fA relation quoted (mA = 57.2 ueV * 1e11 GeV/fA) is a lattice QCD prediction, not a new bound. No extractable exclusion data points.
